GHA.note: The One Million Coders programme is for the public, not civil servants.

systems.platform: data centre and network operations centre
systems.owner: NITA (state), access denied by Smart Infraco

GHA.note: No data centre is said to rent space or computing to others.

facts.fact: Communication Minister Samuel Nartey George said the ministry would launch the One Million Coders programme with a pilot in Greater Accra, Ashanti, Bono and Upper East regions on 16 April, with over 500 participants expected at the launch and a standardised beginner-to-advanced curriculum.

systems.platform: training programme with MTN Group MoU
systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations

facts.fact: Minister George said the Common Monitoring Platform run by the contractor KelniGVG monitors international inbound traffic at fees that rose from 28 to 84 per cent of revenue by October 2024, and instructed the National Communications Authority to take over the revenue assurance platform to reduce reliance on external contractors.

GHA.note: Nothing about local government office connections.
NITA is said to legally own a data centre but be denied access; nothing says it is for hire in service.
Nothing about school internet or curriculum.
